task.title: N6 release acceptance: package portable 0.1.54 through the governed pipeline and verify the packaged payload
task.objective: Produce dist/SpecterStudio 0.1.54.exe with npm run package:portable under a release lease (the version bump 32d2f18 is already committed, so the 0.1.53 artifact is preserved), commit only the signed dependency-manifest pair as release-portable.ps1 does, then run the packaged N6, walkthrough, runtime, licensing and offline gates against the exact payload, recording BLOCKED for license-dependent gates without an authorized issuer key.

acceptance.description: The 0.1.54 portable package is built by the governed pipeline without overwriting 0.1.53, and the packaged N6 gates run against it; license-dependent gates are BLOCKED, never passed, without an authorized issuer key.

evidence.observed: ran under the release lease: offline preflight, memory preflight, build and Zvec staging passed, then prepare-ai-native-host failed because no Visual Studio 2022 MSVC v143 redistributable exists for the app-local runtime DLLs (vswhere absent, awkit-i6ot remedy); no artifact or manifest written, 0.1.53 untouched
no current packaged payload: packaging BLOCKED by the environment; the existing dist/win-unpacked is from 2026-10-13 and the verifier refuses it as stale

history.released_reason: package:portable BLOCKED by environment: prepare-ai-native-host needs Visual Studio 2022 MSVC v143 redist for app-local DLLs, vswhere absent (awkit-i6ot remedy), no manifest written
